qualification: Complete downloaded originals and all ZIP members/CRCs preserved once, including nonzero nested and zero setup views. Root selected rows reproduce primary official-results HTML; the data index itself calls raw technical data courtesy material and says official results are posted by the Board. Full BOE certification/amendment review remains a worker task. Long records use explicit lossless Latin1 byte roundtrip, not an asserted semantic charset. Group3 on the2020 linked2016formatPDF is unlabelled; actual2020 HTML labels matching group3 Emergency ballots. The2022 linked description and matching HTML label it Early Voting. No cross-year/current method equivalence follows. The39 source contexts named Presidential in2020 are absent from Senate; no Senate0 or physical precinct is invented.
